tokens.--text-size: julieedwards.info is a client site with its own reading size and leading, not a family page
tokens.--leading: same: the site's own reading leading
tokens.--page-max: the site's own column width, which Capsomer's .cap-page reads (app/app.css)
tokens.--page-gutter: same: the site's own side padding for Capsomer's .cap-page

copies.public/_headers: generated by site-runtime-headers from the site registry entry, the set the Worker applies; the build rewrites it
